title: CoinGlass 7D restored local decoder and optional official V4 authenticated transport
changes: Restore local six-version CoinGlass decoder from surviving project source; remove deleted BTC_iquidation dependency.
Add official licensed CoinGlass V4 7d max-pain via Cloudflare Worker COINGLASS_API_KEY secret, with 60-second edge cache and normalized authenticated upstream records.
Fallback to preserved six-version legacy reader only if official V4 is unavailable; do not synthesize 15-minute liquidation levels.
Preserve last verified genuine CoinGlass data on error, display stale and suppress RR until fresh success.
Keep WebSocket prices, charts, indicators, CL/WTI mapping, 00:00 and 08:00 clocks unmodified.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite the five frontend files in MultiAssetLiquidityRadar, including the new decoder.
Deploy updated cloudflare/worker.js to existing Worker.
For the official V4 max-pain path, configure Cloudflare Worker Secret COINGLASS_API_KEY using a CoinGlass Professional or Enterprise API key; without this, legacy access may still fail (HTTP 403).
